content.text:
Build a task board web app called "Orbit". It shows three columns -- Todo, In Progress, Done -- each holding task cards. Seed it with six tasks spread across the columns; each card shows a title, an assignee name, and a priority badge (High, Medium, or Low). There is an "Add task" button at the top right. The header reads "Orbit" with the subtitle "Sprint 14". Use a clean light theme.


---
How this run is observed:

- A browser is already open at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ and screenshots it every second, starting
  now. That URL already serves this directory, so a file you save here is on
  screen at the next screenshot. Do not start a server: the port is already
  taken, and every attempt will fail.
- This directory is already a Vite + React project with its dependencies
  installed, and the harness is running its dev server at that URL with hot
  reload: every file you save under `src/` is on screen at the next
  screenshot. Start from `src/App.jsx`, which currently renders nothing. Do
  not start a server or install packages: `react` and `react-dom` are the
  only dependencies, and nothing else can be added.
- Get something on screen as early as you can and then refine it in place. A
  rough page that renders in the first minute counts for more here than a
  perfect one that only appears at the end.
- When you consider the app done, create an empty file named `.p2p-done` in the
  project root. That is what stops the clock. Do not create it before the app is
  on screen.

content.text:
Orbit is built in `src/App.jsx` and should be on screen at the dev server URL. I haven't looked at a screenshot or run it, and I created `.p2p-done` straight after saving.

- **Header:** "Orbit" with the subtitle "Sprint 14", on a clean light theme.
- **Board:** three columns (Todo, In Progress, Done), each with a task count. Two of the six seeded tasks sit in each column.
- **Cards:** each shows a title, an assignee name and a colored priority badge (High, Medium or Low).
- **Add task:** the button at the top right opens a form with title, assignee, priority and column. Saving adds the card to the board. A blank title is ignored, and a blank assignee becomes "Unassigned".

Tasks aren't saved anywhere, so they reset on reload. There is no drag-and-drop, editing or deleting.
